verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Mail Send, SMTP, sandbox mode, the Event Webhook, Inbound Parse, domain authentication, templates and Deliverability Insights, but nothing about reading or managing bounce, spam-complaint or unsubscribe suppression lists via the API. The Event Webhook item only says event data can be posted to a URL. It does not mention suppression-list management or automatic suppression of hard bounces. This is a core axis for an email delivery API, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.
